title: Happy cow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='26' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#e7a8a8'/>
  <!-- patches on body -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='56' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#3a3a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#3a3a55'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='20' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- head patch -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='24' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3a55'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(-20 27 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f5f0e6' transform='rotate(20 73 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e7a8a8' transform='rotate(-20 27 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e7a8a8' transform='rotate(20 73 30)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2b2b44'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2b2b44'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#f0b8b8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='43' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c97070'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='43' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c97070'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52 56 47' stroke='#b85a5a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 16 Q36 8 42 10' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 16 Q64 8 58 10' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
